title: 🧩 Monthly combined test of near-miss ideas
body: 9 small-but-consistent ideas re-tested TOGETHER. Best mix picked on 2020-2022: 0.5*iv30 + 0.3*rv20 + 0.2*rng, next_opex, log(impl) * rank(iv30, 252), 0.5*lag(rng,1) + 0.3*lag(rng5,1) + 0.2*l (+2.77%). On 2023-2025 (never seen): -0.54% -> **NOT CONFIRMED - the combination does not hold on unseen years**
